items.html: And if you consider, you will understand that in the first three months, which is the time when the fetus becomes recognizable — as our sages said, and as will be explained below — the lights of Hesed, Tifferet and Yesod were corrected in them, since Tifferet and Yesod are in the middle line, which is mercy, and therefore they were corrected first, together with Hesed, which is the right line.
